added_papers_note: Two papers were added from social-channel leads: arXiv 2610.20951 (LEV) from the 新浪财经-syndicated WeChat explainer, and arXiv 2610.31315 (The Value of System 1 Models in Medicine) from the exact-title follow-up of the carried-over ResearchGate lead, which returned a different, uncatalogued paper. Both had been invisible to every arXiv API sweep; formal evidence for both comes from the arXiv Atom metadata, abstracts and LaTeXML full text, not from the social posts.
limitations: Sogou WeChat index and X/Twitter search are not authenticated here; coverage relies on web-search indexes, a 新浪财经 syndication of WeChat content, and the Jev-X community index, which had no posts dated 11-01 or 11-02 at run time. The arXiv API sanity probe at Monday 02:45 UTC showed first submissions through 2026-10-30 indexed but nothing from 10-31 through 11-02 (announced Monday 20:00 ET); the next sweep must re-cover 2026-10-31 forward.
